author_report.capacity_unit: GB as authored; no independent GiB conversion

not_bound_by_examined_measurement_sectio: Actual PCI device and original ROM identity
Exact checker source and immutable revision
Checked allocation, launch, synchronization and result-transfer statuses
Original complete readback and independently available digest records
Simultaneous lower and upper allocations with complete lower rechecks after upper writes
Exact refresh register, mask and before/after values
Normal invocation timing and connection to the lab's original firmware inputs
next_useful_evidence: The actual checker/readback artifact or the exact ordinary refresh-field change and invocation contract for this positive run; no guessed register or unchanged expanded-profile replay.
